exam_scheme.note: Recruitment of Pharmacists and technical staff for CGHS wellness centres is conducted through centralized examinations (via SSC Selection Posts Phase examinations and DGHS recruitment tests). The written examination consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) carrying 100 multiple-choice questions of 200 marks with a duration of 60 minutes. Marking scheme: 2 marks for each correct answer and negative marking of 0.50 marks for each incorrect response. Sections include Pharmacy Subject Domain (50 questions, 100 marks), General Intelligence (20 questions, 40 marks), General Awareness (15 questions, 30 marks), and Quantitative Aptitude / Basic English (15 questions, 30 marks). Selection is determined strictly on CBT score followed by document verification.

financial_package.note: Pharmacists in CGHS wellness centres are appointed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 5 (entry basic ₹29,200; pay scale ₹29,200 – ₹92,300) along with Patient Care Allowance where sanctioned and standard central allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: CGHS Recruitment Rules: Pay Matrix Level 5 (₹29,200 – ₹92,300)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 5 Entry Basic ₹29,200 + 58% DA (₹16,936) + HRA (₹8,760 for Class X metro, ₹5,840 for Class Y) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688) + Patient Care Allowance (PCA ~₹4,100/mo). Gross in Class X is ~₹64,684; in-hand is ~₹54,000–₹56,000 after 10% NPS deduction (₹4,614) and standard taxes.
official_perks: Comprehensive healthcare and medical treatment for self and family under CGHS wellness scheme
Patient Care Allowance (PCA) as applicable to dispensary healthcare workers
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution
Central Government Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (₹2,250/month per child)
General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA) eligibility in designated central cities
